data.name: Junkyard Saints: Scrapstorm
data.detailed_description:
SCRAP IS SACRED.

The world ended long ago.

The great cities collapsed beneath endless scrapstorms, reality fractures, and anomalies beyond human understanding. What remains are scattered settlements, wandering scavengers, and the Saints — powerful survivors capable of bending technology, faith, and chaos itself into weapons.

Welcome to Junkyard Saints: Scrapstorm.

A fast-paced Bullet Heaven Action Roguelite where every run is a chance to become an unstoppable force of destruction.

Scavenge the wasteland for powerful gear, experimental technology, unstable relics, and forgotten weapons. Discover procedurally generated loot featuring unique prefixes, suffixes, affixes, and legendary modifiers capable of transforming an entire build. Every run offers new opportunities to experiment, adapt, and discover devastating synergies between weapons, armor, accessories, modules, companions, and Saint abilities.

As abilities reach their full potential, they awaken into Mythic Evolutions that fundamentally change the battlefield. Holy relics unleash cleansing infernos, anomaly storms consume entire enemy waves, and devastating weapon systems transform into instruments of mass destruction. The deeper a run progresses, the more chaotic and spectacular combat becomes.

Beyond the Saints, wandering survivors can be recruited through mysterious radio signals scattered across the wasteland. Their abilities can be mastered directly or brought into battle as AI-controlled companions. Companions gain experience, unlock new behaviors, awaken their powers, and provide powerful support through healing, crowd control, execution abilities, utility effects, and unique build interactions.

Beyond the settlements lies a shattered world waiting to be explored. Travel through handcrafted chapters filled with unique enemies, environmental hazards, dungeon challenges, elite encounters, unique music tracks, and powerful bosses. Every region introduces new threats and mechanics, forcing players to constantly adapt as reality itself becomes increasingly unstable.

Survival is never guaranteed.

Hazard zones, corruption effects, anomaly storms, environmental dangers, and escalating enemy pressure create a constantly evolving battlefield where positioning, movement, and build choices matter as much as raw power. No matter how strong a Saint becomes, the wasteland always finds new ways to fight back.

For those seeking the ultimate challenge, Endless Mode pushes builds beyond their intended limits. Compete through seasonal leaderboards, chase high scores, optimize your loadouts, and discover how far your Saint can survive when the storm never ends.

Junkyard Saints: Scrapstorm also features Twitch Integration, allowing viewers to become part of the wasteland itself. Audiences can vote on events, trigger challenges, influence encounters, spawn special enemies, and directly impact the outcome of a run. Whether they help the streamer survive or sabotage them for their own amusement is entirely up to them.

Built as a long-term live-service experience, Junkyard Saints: Scrapstorm will continue to expand with new Saints, companions, chapters, dungeons, gear, evolutions, cosmetics, seasonal content, and gameplay systems. Progression is designed around player freedom, allowing premium currency to be earned through gameplay so that every scavenger has the opportunity to earn their place in the wasteland.

The storm is coming.

Prepare your Saint.

FEATURES

  • Bullet Heaven Action Roguelite Gameplay

  • Procedural Loot System

  • Mythic Evolutions

  • Unique Saints & Companions

  • Buildcrafting & Synergy Systems

  • Endless Mode

  • Dungeons & Boss Fights

  • Story Campaign

  • Seasonal Content Updates

  • Twitch Integration

  • Character Customization

  • Leaderboards

data.short_description: Survive endless scrapstorms in a post-apocalyptic Bullet Heaven Action Roguelite. Build devastating loadouts, collect procedural gear, awaken powerful Saints, recruit companions, conquer dungeons, and create insane synergies in a world where scrap is sacred.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-Bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
